page.layout: One page of running text in one column, with a head at the top across the full width ("EIRENICI" over "PARS PRIMA."). A large woodcut initial N opens the text. No margin notes. Catchword "tam" at the lower right, signature "A 5" at the lower left.

main_text.l: EIRENICI
PARS PRIMA.
NATURALE studium est om-
niumi ut fruantur bono; & ad
fructum boni consequendum
depellunt à se contraria natu-
ræ luce, quibus oppugnatur bo-
num. Hunc autem appetitum,
qui rebus omnibus naturalis est, multa insuper
accidētia solent acuere; inprimis autem mole-
stæ malorum infestantiū moles & fluctus pro-
cellarum: qui quo grauius impendent atque ex-
agitant, eo plus animi humani premuntur solli-
citudine. Ac sollicitudo quidem de proprio &
singulari bono ita est singulis indita, ut moneri
quemquam non sit opus de bonis singularibus
& privatis cōmodis persequendis, aut propul-
sandis incommodis. Sed cùm à natura ita fit
comparatum, ut singula quæque ad unum ali-
quod commune bonum referantur, homines
verò supra res creatas cæteras per singularem
Dei gratiam luce rationis, & quàm plurimis ad
bonum adiumentis instructi sint: quod indi-
gnum aliis rebus existimát, eas à bono cōmuni
discedere, id multo amplius de se ipsi debent
statuere: qui & bono proprio instructi, & ad
commune documentis tam multis provocati,
tam

page.notes: Page number and running head are not printed. The woodcut initial N is joined to "ATVRALE" as "NATURALE". Printed text reads "omniumi" and "accidētia" with some doubt about the macron and the vowel; the scan is low-resolution there, so these are not marked with [?]. "fruftum" was read as "fructum" (long s/ct ligature). "fandis" was read as "sandis" from "propulsandis". Word "tam" at the foot is the catchword, and the text is carried over to the next page.
